label: sec:golden-julia-dynamics-intro
html:
The Reeb flow on the exceptional divisor does not inherently require a discrete time step. Here, we discretize it into Planck units to read off the symbolic dynamics on the Descartes elliptic curve \mathcal{E}_q. The golden ratio \varphi appears twice: as a metric ratio at q_0 and as an algebraic root at q_{\mathrm{gold}} = 1/\varphi^2.

The remarks that follow establish this structure. Parallel transport of a golden-ratio parallelogram to q_{\mathrm{gold}} carries a fundamental domain of the chiral fiber along the q-connection. This demonstrates that the two occurrences of \varphi represent the same algebraic number viewed from opposite ends of the substrate parameter space. The Julia set of the Reeb flow identifies the invariant set of the iterated Reeb map. We then define the operational entropy of the Reeb dynamics to extract the metric entropy \eta_q = (2q-1)/q^3 via the Bowen--Ruelle thermodynamic formalism.

One Planck step of Reeb flow anchors the time variable at the Big Bang initial state \mathcal{S}_0. Taylor approximation of the energy E at the Big Bang identifies the k-th Planck step with the k-th floor of the brane tower A_k. The subsequent section consumes \eta_q and the Planck step to construct the speed of light c_q and mass \mathfrak{m}.
